## Community

![](images/hacky-hours.png){fig-align="center"}

Look out for local **Hacky Hours** — informal drop-in sessions where researchers share coding tips, get unstuck, and build community. A low-pressure way to keep the momentum going after the workshop.

## Tools & platforms

- [re3data.org](https://www.re3data.org) — registry of 2,000+ research data repositories, searchable by subject and data type
- [choosealicense.com](https://choosealicense.com) — plain-English guide to choosing an open source licence
- [gitignore.io](https://www.gitignore.io) — generate `.gitignore` templates for any language or IDE
- [cffinit](https://citation-file-format.github.io/cff-initializer-javascript/) — browser-based `CITATION.cff` generator
- [shields.io](https://shields.io) — generate badges for licences, DOIs, build status, and more
- [Quarto Manuscripts](https://quarto.org/docs/manuscripts/) — publish code and data integrated into manuscripts
- [Code Ocean](https://codeocean.com) — platform for executable, citable code capsules
- [Snakemake](https://snakemake.readthedocs.io/en/stable/) — automate reproducible analysis workflows
- [GitHub templates](https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/creating-and-managing-repositories/creating-a-repository-from-a-template) — create standardised repo structures for new projects

## Reading & learning

- [FAIR principles](https://www.go-fair.org/fair-principles/) — Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable — the framework underpinning open science
- [The Turing Way](https://book.the-turing-way.org/) — comprehensive, community-built handbook for reproducible research
- [Software Carpentry: Better Research Software](https://carpentries-incubator.github.io/better-research-software/) — hands-on workshop for research computing
- [Data Carpentry: Data Management](https://datacarpentry.org/data-management/) — workshop on managing and sharing research data
- [ReproducibiliTea](https://www.reproducibilitea.org/) — journal club and community for open and reproducible research
